newsitem.title: USA: Schult Homes to split stock 6-for-5.
newsitem.headline: Schult Homes to split stock 6-for-5.

text.p: Schult Homes Corp said it authorized a six-for-five stock split.
The company also said it will maintain its regular quarterly cash dividend post-split at $0.05 per share, effectively increasing the total dividend by 20 percent.
The additional shares will be distributed on February 28 to shareholders of record as of the close of business on February 14, Schult said.
Schult Homes has about 3.75 million shares outstanding. After the split becomes effective, the company said it will have 4.5 million shares outstanding.
The board also declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.05 per share to be paid on February 28, to holders of record as of the close of business on February 14.
"Because the dividend rate per share is being held constant, the company is effectively increasing the amount of its total dividend by 20 percent," Schult said.
"The cash dividend will be paid on a post split basis so the increase will become effective with the current payment," said the producer of manufactured and modular homes.
